description: Ubuntu LTS, Node LTS, Fastify, Kysely and PostgreSQL baseline for a systemd-managed service without a container runtime, process manager or frontend framework slot.
compatibility_rules: Node must be an upstream LTS version and is executed directly by a systemd unit; no container runtime and no process manager layer sits between systemd and the application process.
TypeScript build output must run on the declared Node major without a separate runtime image; this profile has no OCI slot and therefore no digest-pinned base image obligation.

This profile declares a framework slot and a query-builder slot alongside the runtime; it declares no frontend, proxy or container slot. A project may additionally declare other catalog components, and any framework or query builder that is not a catalog component stays pinned in the application repository lock file.
A transition selects exactly one component per slot, requires an absolute HTTPS migration Issue plus one matching unexpired exception, and never permits a prohibited component.
PostgreSQL major adoption requires a separate backup, restore and rollback-capable project Change.

constraints.deployment: systemd-native/v1 describes delivery ownership only and grants no deployment capability; container and PM2 delivery are out of scope for this profile, so an application that adopts either must move to the matching profile and delivery contract.
constraints.data_storage: PostgreSQL data resides on approved local or managed persistent storage, never inside the systemd unit working directory or a release artifact directory.
constraints.concurrency: Database connection and worker limits are owned and load-tested by each application Change; a systemd restart policy must not be used to mask a saturated pool.
constraints.availability: Availability topology is declared outside this architecture lock and remains owned by host/release governance; a single systemd unit implies no high-availability claim.
constraints.backup: A database major Change requires a verified backup before mutation.
constraints.restore_drill: A restore drill plus a proven previous-release restoration is required before production adoption of a new PostgreSQL major.
